ai.literal: For those who wage war, a fortress is an asset; and for those who, fearing, protect themselves, it is also an asset.
ai.translation: A fortress is an indispensable asset for those who take the offensive, as well as for those who, out of fear, seek only to protect themselves.
ai.modern: போர் செய்யத் தொடங்குபவர்களுக்கும் அரண் ஒரு சிறந்த துணையாகும்; பகைவருக்கு அஞ்சித் தங்களைப் பாதுகாத்துக் கொள்ள நினைப்பவர்களுக்கும் அது ஒரு சிறந்த துணையாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the universal importance of a fortress (அரண்) in warfare and defense. The author states that a fortress is a valuable asset (பொருள்) for two distinct groups of people. First, for those who actively wage war or take the offensive (ஆற்றுபவர்), it serves as a secure base of operations. Second, for those who are afraid of the enemy and seek only to guard themselves (அஞ்சித் தற்போற்றுபவர்), it provides a safe refuge. Thus, whether one is attacking or defending, a strong fort is an indispensable necessity.

ai.literal: Crystal-clear water, land, a mountain, and a beautifully shaded forest—that which possesses [these] is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is that which possesses crystal-clear water, open land, a high mountain, and a forest of beautiful, protective shade.
ai.modern: தெளிந்த நீரும், நிலமும், மலையும், அழகிய நிழலைத் தரும் காடும் கொண்டதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the four essential natural elements that constitute a perfect defensive fortress (அரண்). First is 'மணிநீர்' (crystal-clear, gem-like water) which ensures a reliable water supply for those inside. Second is 'மண்' (fertile land or open space) which provides resources and space. Third is 'மலை' (a mountain) which offers a natural high vantage point and physical barrier. Fourth is 'அணிநிழற் காடு' (a forest with beautiful, dense shade) which provides cover, resources, and further defense. A stronghold possessing all four of these natural features is virtually impregnable.

ai.literal: Height, width, strength, impenetrability—the possession of these four, a fortress, thus describes the treatise.
ai.translation: The authoritative treatises declare that a true fortress is one that possesses these four qualities: height, width, strength, and impenetrability.
ai.modern: உயரம், அகலம், வலிமை, எளிதில் கடக்க முடியாத அருமை ஆகிய இந்த நான்கும் பொருந்தி இருப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் என்று நூல்கள் கூறுகின்றன.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the physical and strategic characteristics of an ideal fortress. According to military science or authoritative treatises (நூல்), a fortress must have four essential attributes: height (உயர்வு) to prevent easy scaling, width (அகலம்) to accommodate defenders and space, strength (திண்மை) of construction to withstand attacks, and impenetrability or difficulty of access (அருமை) to keep enemies at bay. The word 'அமைவு' indicates the perfect fitting or possession of these four qualities. When a fortification possesses all four, it is recognized as a complete and effective defense system.

ai.literal: With small defense, being of large space, that which destroys the zeal of the intense enemy is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is one that requires only a small force to defend, offers ample space inside, and destroys the zeal of the attacking enemy.
ai.modern: குறைந்த காவலுடன், பெரிய இடத்தைக் கொண்டு, வந்து தாக்கும் பகைவரின் ஊக்கத்தை அழிப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of an effective fortress (அரண்). First, it must require only a small guarding force (சிறுகாப்பு) to defend it, meaning its design makes it easy to secure. Second, it must have a large interior space (பேரிடத்தது) to accommodate people, provisions, and troops comfortably during a siege. Finally, its formidable nature must be such that it dampens and destroys the determination and zeal (ஊக்கம்) of even a powerful attacking enemy (உறுபகை). These physical and psychological advantages make a fortification truly secure.

ai.literal: To be captured being difficult, having food provisions, for those inside to defend being easy, of such nature is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is that which is difficult for enemies to capture, well-stocked with food and resources, and easy for those inside to defend.
ai.modern: பகைவர்களால் கைப்பற்றுவதற்கு அரியதாய், தேவையான உணவுப் பொருட்களைக் கொண்டதாய், உள்ளே இருப்பவர்கள் நின்று போரிடுவதற்கு எளியதாய் இருப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential qualities of an effective fortress. First, it must be structurally secure and strategically situated so that it is extremely difficult for enemies to capture (கொளற்கரிதாய்). Second, it must be self-sufficient and stocked with ample food and provisions (கொண்டகூழ்த்து) to withstand long sieges. Finally, its design must make it easy and advantageous for the defenders inside to hold their ground and fight back (அகத்தார் நிலைக்கு எளிதாம்).

ai.literal: All resources and having, in times of need that helps, excellent defenders that which possesses, is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is one that possesses all necessary resources and is manned by excellent defenders who will stand and help in times of need.
ai.modern: எல்லாத் தேவையான பொருள்களையும் கொண்டு, ஆபத்து காலத்தில் உதவி செய்யக்கூடிய நல்ல வீரர்களைக் கொண்டிருப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential internal qualities of a strong fortress. It states that a fortress must not only be stocked with all necessary provisions and resources to withstand a long siege, but it must also be manned by capable, loyal, and brave defenders who will actively fight and help during a crisis. The word 'ஆள்' here refers to the soldiers or defenders, and 'நல்' emphasizes their skill and loyalty. Without both material resources and dependable defenders, a physical structure cannot function as a true fortress.

ai.literal: Even by besieging, or without besieging by attacking, or even by undermining from within, to capture difficult is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is one that is impossible to capture, whether by laying a long siege, by launching a sudden direct assault, or by attempting to undermine it through internal treachery.
ai.modern: முற்றுகையிட்டோ, முற்றுகையிடாமல் திடீரென்று தாக்கியோ, அல்லது உள்ளிருப்பவர்களை வஞ்சனையால் வசப்படுத்தியோ கைப்பற்றுவதற்கு அரியதே சிறந்த அரணாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate strength of a fortress by listing the three primary methods used to capture one. 'Muṟṟiyum' refers to surrounding the fort in a prolonged siege to starve the defenders. 'Muṟṟātu eṟintum' refers to bypassing a siege and launching an immediate, aggressive storming of the walls. 'Aṟaippaṭuttum' refers to the act of bribing or deceiving those inside to betray the fort from within. A perfect fortress (araṇ) is one that remains impregnable (paṟṟaṟku ariyatu) against all three of these tactics.

ai.literal: Performing a siege, even those who have besieged, sustaining their defense, those who hold fast conquering, is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is one that enables its defenders, holding fast to their stronghold, to defeat even those who have laid a complete siege against them.
ai.modern: முற்றுகையிட்டுப் போரிடும் பகைவர்களையும், தங்களுக்குரிய பற்றுக் கோட்டை விடாமல் காக்கும் கோட்டைவாசிகள் வெல்ல உதவுவதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate military value of a fortress. A true fort (அரண்) is not just a passive barrier, but an active tactical advantage that allows the defenders (பற்றியார்) who hold onto their stronghold (பற்று ஆற்றி) to overcome and defeat even a powerful enemy army that has completely surrounded and besieged them (முற்று ஆற்றி முற்றியவரையும்). The word 'முற்று' refers to a complete encirclement or siege, while 'பற்று' represents the defensive grip or the stronghold itself. The couplet highlights that a fort's design must empower a smaller, defending force to triumph over a besieging force.

ai.literal: At the battlefront enemies to perish, in the execution of action triumph having attained, that which is excellent is the fortress.
ai.translation: An excellent fortress is one that enables its defenders to achieve triumph in their operations, causing the enemies to perish at the very battlefront.
ai.modern: போர்க்களத்தில் பகைவர்கள் அழியும்படி, தன் பாதுகாப்புச் செயல்பாடுகளில் பெருமை பெற்று விளங்குவதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate purpose and excellence of a fortress. A true fortress is not merely a passive barrier; it must actively facilitate the military operations of its defenders. By enabling the defenders to achieve triumph in their strategic actions, it ensures that the invading enemies perish right at the battlefront. Thus, the greatness of a fort lies in its active contribution to victory.

ai.literal: Of whatever greatness having become even in the case of, excellence of action in those who lack, non-existent is the fortress.
ai.translation: Even if a fortress possesses every kind of greatness, it is as good as non-existent for those who lack excellence in action.
ai.modern: எவ்வளவு பெருமைகளைக் கொண்டதாக ஒரு கோட்டை இருந்தாலும், செயலில் சிறந்த திறமை இல்லாதவர்களிடம் அது இல்லாததற்குச் சமம் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes that physical defenses are only as good as the people who man them. A fortress may have every imaginable greatness, such as high walls, deep moats, and ample resources. However, if the defenders lack excellence of action, the fort becomes completely useless. Ultimately, the true strength of a defense lies in the skill and bravery of its defenders, not just its physical structure.
